name: stt-eval-seed
description: Seed evaluation set for the transcription capability. Immutable once released: changes create v2. Two public-domain speech clips with exact reference transcripts (pinned to release tags + SHA-256) and two deterministic synthetic probes with empty references (silence hallucination + non-speech audio). v2 (planned, M2 step 5) adds curated real-world clips including user-recorded English and Hindi read speech.

clips.notes: Same speech via the WAV decode path — container handling must not change the transcript.
Hallucination probe: every emitted word is a failure. Targets Whisper's documented silence failure mode; gates the VAD pipeline stage.
Non-speech audio probe (pure tone): correct output is an empty transcript.
